messages:
casey: Heads up — several customers report SCIM deprovision 403s after tonight's infra roll. KMS logs show both AccessDeniedException and InvalidCiphertext in the same window. Anyone touch RBAC or key rotation?

jia: I deployed an RBAC tightening PR at 2026-12-02T22:07Z that removed some broad kms:* allowances. Intended to limit admin perms but might have been too aggressive for svc roles.

marco: Correlating traces: scim-provisioner attempts failed with: 
```
2026-12-02T22:12:44Z ERROR scim-provisioner tenant=delta status=403 err=decrypt_failed
2026-12-02T22:12:44Z ERROR kms: Decrypt failed key=alias/scim-secrets err=AccessDeniedException
2026-12-02T22:12:46Z ERROR kms: Decrypt failed key=alias/scim-secrets err=InvalidCiphertextException ctx="{\"issuer\":\"https://idp.example/\"}"
```

oncall-sam: I'm oncall and can push a temporary grant for Decrypt to the scim role and run a backfill. I can also roll back the RBAC change if needed. Which path do we take?

security-bot: Detected change: iam policy "provisioner-tighten" by jia at 2026-12-02T22:07Z removed explicit Allow for kms:Decrypt to arn:aws:iam::123456:role/scim-provisioner. Automated audit flagged this as high-risk for provisioning flows.

casey: Quick mitigation: grant + backfill so customers recover. Long-term: add CI gate to simulate iam -> kms deps and preserve key policy exceptions.

jia: Adding PR to reintroduce a narrowly-scoped allow for scim-provisioner and adding `rcli iam simulate` to CI. PR: https://git.redwood/iam/PR-1024.

marco: Note the InvalidCiphertextException implies some blobs were rewrapped or encryption_context changed (maybe SAML issuer formatting). Need to gather rotation audit and context diffs.

oncall-sam: Temp grant created at 2026-12-02T22:32Z (AUDIT:G-3009). Backfill started; early recovery looks good. I'll revoke the grant after 1hr and post audit.

compliance-olga: Please attach CloudTrail KMS events, RBAC diff, and list of impacted tenants to INC-10211 for the compliance packet. We'll need operator signatures for any rewrap.

casey: Action items: jia - roll-forward PR + tests (owner); marco - collect rotation/context diffs and tenant impact list (owner); oncall-sam - revoke grant after stabilization and upload audit (owner); security-bot - add alert on KMS AccessDenied for scim-provisioner >3/min (owner).

security-bot: Recommended severity: medium (config/RBAC regression). Suggest runbook update: pre-deploy simulation of KMS permissions and do not tie encryption_context to mutable request headers.

casey: Thanks — schedule 30m postmortem tomorrow. Closing thread once incident doc updated. :white_check_mark:
